Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjiv Berry

Present : Mr. Deepak Aggarwal, Advocate for the petitioners.
 Mr. Subhash Godara, Additional A.G. Punjab.
 Mr. Dilraj Singh Bhinder, Advocate for respondent No.2.
 *****
Sanjiv Berry.
J. (Oral)

By way of present petition filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973,
petitioners seek quashing of FIR (Annexure P-1) and all consequential proceedings arising therefrom on the basis of compromise/settlement dated 23.09.2023 (Annexure P-2) executed between the parties.

Details of the FIR are as follows:
FIR No. Dated Sections Police Station 90 12.07.2023 447, 511, 379 IPC Cantt Bathinda, (420, 465, 466, 471 and 120-B District Bathinda IPC added later on)
2.

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of respondent No.2 has categorically stated that the compromise (Annexure P-2) was only for the purpose of bail and it has been specifically stated therein that the first party i.e.respondent No.2 has agreed not to oppose the bail of the present petitioner before the competent Court and the petitioner has since been granted the concession of bail.

He categorically submits that there is no compromise between the parties qua the 1 of 2 Neutral Maninder Pal Singh Alias Maninder Singh ... vs State Of Punjab And Anr on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13984960/
